raw_response:
This small maize plot is right next to my house, only a small piece of my land. I went to school a little, so I can read the bag, but I still do what my father did and what my neighbors do. I will put a little DAP at planting and some urea when the maize is knee-high, because the cooperative brings it and my neighbors who use it get better cobs. I keep local seed from last harvest because improved seed costs money and this plot is too small to risk, and I will weed it myself with my brothers — no need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
